workload_user_confirmed: User reconfirmed matching connected Pods views after Freelens reopening. No independent Accessibility inspection. Exact cluster, namespace and Pod count not retained.
method: Validation capture; CPU units corrected from retained Mach ticks using host timebase. Not the README result set.
limitations: Workload/view equivalence is user-confirmed; Accessibility access denied
Concurrent apps, existing profiles and unrelated host activity; not controlled cold starts
Exiting processes may lose final CPU deltas; sub-second helpers may be missed
Not latency, energy, GPU utilization, network throughput, or feature-parity measurements
Physical-footprint sums are process charges, not unique system-wide pages
